availability: A bar is available only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time. Future rows are ignored. Each admitted symbol requires one exact contiguous 126-bar timestamp suffix on the selected modal grid; invalid high, low, or quote-volume values remain unavailable and are never imputed.
transforms: unsigned log(high / low) for each valid past-closed bar
timestamp-wise quote-volume share across currently eligible valid native-crypto symbols
impact proxy = unsigned log range / max(valid positive quote-volume share, 1e-5)
per-symbol median impact over a 105-bar baseline window and disjoint 21-bar recent window
raw depth improvement = log(baseline median impact / recent median impact)
final score = centered cross-sectional fractional rank of raw depth improvement
a5_boundary: The complete final finite built-in rank-score dict[str,float] crosses strategy.score_boundary once. Returned values determine score span and selection; raw depth improvement is used only for the preregistered post-selection sleeve-separation gate.
execution_owner: The organizer owns orders, fills, costs, funding cashflows, risk state, membership exits, and next-open execution.
